# taxmap

> AI-assisted, evidence-backed tax and special-assessment maps. Agents interpret
> records; deterministic MCP tools store, extract, validate, and build.

## Documentation
- [Documentation hub](docs/): choose between using a map and creating a map.
- [Use a map](docs/use.html): reader hub; no installation or AI agent needed.
- [Create a map](docs/create.html): project creator hub with agent-assisted,
  developer, and AI-agent reference workflows.
- [App user guide](docs/users.html): parcel search, district cards, calculators,
  sources, official amounts versus estimates, and map limitations.
- [Build with an AI agent](docs/community.html): install/sign into one CLI,
  follow SETUP.md, activate and verify live tools, then say
  "Build a taxmap app for Martinez, CA."
  Safe defaults, research, one exact content review and a checked local preview.
  Optional setup walkthrough, direct installer and separate deployment approval.
- [Developer guide](docs/developers.html): one-request lifecycle, manual CLI/files,
  models, tests, reviewed exports and deployment.
- [Agent playbook](docs/agents.txt): plain-text workflow and evidence contract.
- [Agent HTML guide](docs/agents.html): browsable tool-oriented instructions.

## Reference
- [Shared jurisdiction resources](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/taxmap-resources):
  reusable official city/county websites, agenda/minute portals, GIS services and
  bill templates, not specific documents or individual bills. The lookup skill
  reverifies matching leads. One-request builds offer eligible additions/corrections
  alongside preview review, explaining the community benefit and asking a separate
  explicit sharing choice with no preselected consent. No changes means no prompt;
  declined/deferred choices are respected on resume and never block the app.
  Approved sharing uses the contribution skill, fork-based PRs and maintainer
  review/merge. Preview approval never permits sharing. No automatic publication.
- [Repository](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map)
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [CLI tools bootstrap](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/SETUP.md):
  one persistent multi-skill plugin with projectless MCP; verify live skills/tools
  after client-supported activation. No blanket restart; Codex setup requires
  a full desktop-app quit/reopen or CLI exit/relaunch, then a fresh conversation. Tools-only setup does not create a city project.
- [Disconnect tools](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/UNINSTALL.md):
  uninstall-skill fallback, native plugin enable/disable/removal, legacy cleanup,
  and project/data preservation.
- [Plugin source](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/plugin.json):
  shared skill bundle; setup generates local machine-specific MCP and client adapters.
- [Skills](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/tree/main/skills)
- [One-request app skill](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/skills/build-taxmap-app/SKILL.md):
  optional guided generation; individual skills and manual tools remain supported.
- [Typed models](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/src/taxmap/domain/models.py)
- [MCP server](https://github.com/Cocoa-County/tax-map/blob/main/src/taxmap/mcp/server.py)
- [Concord example](concord/): unofficial FY 2026-27 research map.

Use live MCP schemas for exact parameters. The county bill and adopted roll
remain authoritative; model coverage and calculator estimates are limited.
Integrity is not financial reconciliation. Partial previews preserve source
discrepancies and disclose gaps. Guided app.yaml stores progress/approval;
app_preview returns the checked export under .taxmap/app-previews, while manual
builds default to site/. Publish only a separately approved export, never the
whole cache. Source edits alone do not update an installed runtime/plugin.
